name: command-code-chat
description: Chat sidebar for Command Code — the coding agent that learns your taste

commands.title: Command Code Chat: Stop Current Run
Command Code Chat: Clear Context Chips
Command Code Chat: Add Current File to Context
Command Code Chat: Add Selection to Context

commandCodeChat.commandPath.description: Path to the Command Code CLI executable.

commandCodeChat.model.description: Command Code model to use for chat sessions.

commandCodeChat.enableIdeSetup.description: Experimental. Pass --ide-setup to Command Code. Disabled by default because it can intercept print-mode chats with IDE setup messages.

commandCodeChat.idleTimeoutMs.description: Kill the CLI if it stays idle for too long (milliseconds).

commandCodeChat.autoRetryOnServerError.description: Retry once with a fallback model if the CLI returns an internal server error.

commandCodeChat.maxQueueLength.description: Maximum number of queued messages retained in memory.

commandCodeChat.defaultMode.description: Default permission mode for new chats.

commandCodeChat.maxTurns.description: Maximum conversation turns in non-interactive mode.

commandCodeChat.trustProject.description: Auto-trust the project (skip initial permission prompt).

commandCodeChat.skipOnboarding.description: Skip taste onboarding for automated runs.

commandCodeChat.includeOpenFile.description: Include active file path in the prompt.

commandCodeChat.includeSelection.description: Include selected text from the active editor in the prompt.

commandCodeChat.historyTurns.description: Recent chat history turns to include in each prompt.

commandCodeChat.maxContextFileKb.description: Maximum file size (KB) to read into context via # file references.

commandCodeChat.clearContextAfterSend.description: Clear context chips after sending a message.

commandCodeChat.enableSlashCommands.description: Enable slash commands in chat input.

commandCodeChat.compactMode.description: Use extra-compact spacing in the chat UI.

commandCodeChat.debug.description: Enable debug logging to the extension output channel.
